candidate_models_not_selected.reason: Dated models with documented tool calling and Chat Completions support; price anchors, subject to team choice and account availability.

proposed_effective_settings_require_revi.notice: Output caps and reasoning settings are proposals, not installed runtime changes. Preserve prompt/tool/scoring semantics. Apply identical role settings on both sides and diagnose length truncation. Native max_tokens wire compatibility requires a verified common provider endpoint or documented symmetric transport mapping.

phases.gate: Version pins, isolation review, live-only entry wiring, protocol fixtures, and enforceable request-level budget accounting.

phases.first_checkpoint: Run case_040 on each side, then review billed usage and protocol behavior before the remaining four. These two episodes are included in ten.
phases.gate: Explicit user authorization and funded provider access; this is not formal model parity.
Build and validate the five adaptive controllers; review A1 and obtain scope/budget authorization.
Build and qualify remaining controllers; agree required independent-customer oracle coverage with the team. A1+A2+A3=100 episodes, no double counting.
Team-approved matched HTTPAgent/relay implementation, models, task set and budget; separate user authorization. Diagnostic task set, not a representative score estimate.
Both sides of B0 diagnosed; recalibrate cost with long-task usage; approve next tranche.
One full round complete on both sides. B1+B2=300 scored episodes, B0 separate.

acceptance_and_recording.oracle: Record native G/P/F/Strict and customer behavior, including failures. A five-case pilot does not satisfy a full-50 live oracle claim. Never force customer approval or weaken native checks.
acceptance_and_recording.parity: Report each side's run means and sample SEM over three full runs; compare run-score ranges. Model failures stay in scores, infrastructure failures remain separately classified. Investigate divergence; no best-of retries.
acceptance_and_recording.budget_interruption: Retain incomplete episode and budget-stop reason; do not replace its score or claim completed parity.

isolation.assistant: Only public assistant messages/tools; no grader, private world, hidden contract or scripted customer answers.
isolation.customer: Unmodified native customer policy and customer portal tools in its own role; no grader or reference answer injection.
isolation.grader: Trusted business evidence collected after stopping assistant; fresh separate offline verifier, no model credentials and no scoring feedback during the episode. Native in-process verification artifacts are not exposed to the live assistant.

blocking_work_before_launch: Freeze verified Harbor Git revision and adapter/controller identity; installed wheel alone does not establish source revision.
Implement live-customer entry wiring without scripted customer fixtures; existing adaptive scripts remain offline-only.
Validate model endpoint wire semantics, context/output caps and usage reporting without altering benchmark prompts/scoring.
Implement pre-request cost reservation using actual token accounting and maximum output charges, plus an enforceable gateway/provider cap. Alerts alone are not a hard cap.
Confirm model/account access, rates including applicable surcharges, and staged explicit approval.
For B phases, obtain Harbor team agreement, including whether standard-agent comparison is additionally required.
